answer: On the winter tundra a way-station used to wave through anyone who flashed a copied lantern code, so one wallet could staff a whole relief line. Each new worker must now grow a lotus seal in a numbered ice pot, lock 58 units, and publish C=H(pot_serial||shift_id||pubkey||frost_bin) before a 70-minute dusk census. Seven rangers reopen the commit and replay the pot log; the lock releases after 16 hours only if the serial is unused. If two keys share a pot or a shift, both locks burn and the serial is cancelled, so every extra head costs more than it returns.
